updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: OCR Support for Endpoint
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP will gain optical character recognition capabilities to detect sensitive content embedded in images on Windows endpoints and enforce data loss prevention policies. This expansion supports common image formats (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP) and PDFs, closing a gap in protecting visual data from exfiltration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management Experience Evolution
updates.summary: Purview DSPM is being overhauled to unify visibility and control across traditional and AI-driven data environments, with outcome-based workflows, AI observability, and Security Copilot-powered automation for triage and policy management. This enhancement helps organizations rapidly identify and remediate data risks as they scale AI adoption.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A weak authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations running Exchange should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69435: Azure SRE Agent Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authorization checks in the Azure SRE Agent allow an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over a network. This vulnerability affects identity and access control in Azure infrastructure management.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending existing classification and governance policies without requiring separate label configuration. This unifies information protection across both Microsoft 365 and Entra security groups.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
updates.summary: A new export feature allows administrators to download DLP and label publishing policies as ZIP files from the Purview portal, streamlining troubleshooting and support ticket escalation. This capability improves auditability and disaster recovery planning for compliance policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logs will now provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions within the Purview portal, helping administrators troubleshoot authorization issues and monitor role effectiveness. This improvement strengthens governance and compliance monitoring.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Upgraded DLP Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps is being upgraded to integrate with Conditional Access grant controls, offering expanded policy conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and improved visibility in activity explorer. This simplifies configuration while increasing policy flexibility for Entra-integrated scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to classify and protect significantly more data at rest. This acceleration helps close labeling gaps and better prepares data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and Collection Policies for Intune Mobile Application Management
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends to Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling content-aware protection policies that evaluate clipboard actions and data sharing against DLP rules before allowing transfer. This integration closes a critical gap in mobile data protection and reduces insider risk.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Note Collaboration in Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows analysts to add notes directly within alerts, with automatic system-generated notes tracking status changes and user assignments. This centralized investigation history improves collaboration and audit trails for threat response workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Enhanced User Profile in Alerts
updates.summary: IRM alert workflows now display expanded user profile data including employee type, office location, start date, priority user status, and last working day, allowing investigators to assess risk context without leaving the alert interface. This contextual enhancement accelerates investigation triage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access (General Availability)
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect text, files, and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking risky sharing to untrusted cloud applications and detecting malicious activity through Insider Risk Management. This network-layer enforcement prevents sensitive data leakage across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new compliance report feature enables administrators to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that fall out of compliance after Information Barriers policy changes. This visibility helps enforce segmentation policies and reduce insider risk.
